title: Concierge autonomous domain procurement with human spending boundary
owner: Existing concierge-task intent / Fleet Concierge Tasks + mums-concierge operator

requirements.rule: Accept one idempotent task_id, structured domain candidates, max budget, jurisdiction, source and founder session; use existing concierge-task and avoid duplicate tasks
requirements.falsifier: Two concurrent identical requests cannot produce two checkout commitments

requirements.rule: Preflight actual executor availability, browser session, authentication scope, DNS/RDAP lookup ability and evidence storage before announcing RUNNING; unavailable reports BLIND with recovery route
requirements.falsifier: Missing laptop executor returns 503 and must not show running or done

requirements.rule: Perform domain registration lookup from authoritative registry plus current registrar quote; attach UTC time, request identity, response semantics, credibility and TTL
requirements.falsifier: NXDOMAIN/DNS failure, masked RDAP, stale quote or failed vendor login never certifies purchasability

requirements.rule: Explain naming/trademark collisions and compare registrars using cited source evidence; structured proposed choice only, no authority to purchase
At checkout stop at existing --never-pay hold; produce exact domain, registry period, payee, price, tax, auto-renew, privacy, registrar, checkout URL and approval expiry
requirements.falsifier: Zero payment steps, zero stored PAN/CVV and zero offer/bid from an unapproved task

requirements.rule: Founder explicitly approves vendor/domain/amount/period in an authenticated bounded channel; authorization expires and cannot transfer to another domain or amount
requirements.falsifier: Approval replay, changed amount or different item invalidated

requirements.rule: After legitimately approved transaction, verify order/registrar account control, domain status, registrant identity/privacy, renewal and DNS readback using independent channels; mark unknown fields UNKNOWN
requirements.falsifier: A payment receipt alone never becomes owned-and-operational status

requirements.rule: Append signed/digested events with task_id and causal evidence; deduplicate retries and founder notifications; return to Fleet as tri-state receipt
requirements.falsifier: Truncated event log or missing final receipt cannot be shown as success

acceptance: Read-only search completes without human/browser payment
Purchase pathway always holds until founder approval
Task remains observable in Fleet including BLIND and stale states
Actual domain purchase and DNS effects validated independently only after explicit approval
dependencies: existing Concierge runner credentials/browser and payment boundary
scope: One real dry research run, no purchase permitted in spec phase
